description: This Java class defines the configuration for persistence cleanup in the Eclipse Ditto project, including parameters like enabled status, durations, parallelism, and related sub-configurations.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceCleanupConfig
classes.description: Implementation of PersistenceCleanupConfig that loads and provides persistence cleanup settings from a Config object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a PersistenceCleanupConfig instance from a service-specific Config, with fallback.

methods.name: updated
methods.description: Creates a PersistenceCleanupConfig instance from an extracted Config.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether persistence cleanup is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the quiet period.

methods.name: getKeptCreditDecisions
methods.description: Returns the number of kept credit decisions.

methods.name: getKeptActions
methods.description: Returns the number of kept actions.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of kept events.
